headline: LLM agents and multimodal models convert literature and spectra into molecular knowledge
label: Agentic Llm Molecular Discovery
summary: Agentic, evidence-tracked LLM pipelines are now being benchmarked against literature extraction, metabolite identification and drug repurposing tasks.
synthesis: The shared thread is learned models that convert heterogeneous scientific data into structured molecular knowledge, increasingly organised as agentic systems. BioMiner uses a multimodal LLM to extract protein-ligand bioactivity triplets from literature text, tables and figures, evaluated on the BioVista benchmark. In mass spectrometry, MSAgent orchestrates more than 50 MS tools in an evidence-grounded workflow that improves CASMI retrieval MRR by over 10%. Drug repurposing preprints follow a similar pattern: LinkD unifies diffusion-based affinity prediction, selectivity scoring, phenotypic data and clinical evidence; RepurAgent adds human-supervised hypothesis generation; and the Open Intelligence Hub coordinates 32 containerised tools for binder design and ADC prioritization. What is new is the shift from fixed predictors toward agentic, evidence-tracked pipelines. Reported results remain largely benchmark-based or computational, so prospective validation is not established across these items.
